chapter: Second interview: bass, Parker and Miles
title: Why Jimmy Blanton mattered, and jazz bass versus classical bass
summary: Blanton played high and low in all keys, unlike Walter Page; a story of a bass player who could not sight-read; classical bass soloists seem simple by comparison.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
